As a family-owned and operated pool service and maintenance company in North Texas, we understand the importance of exceptional service. Our dedicated team is committed to keeping your pool sparkling clean and thriving year-round. Whether it's routine maintenance, repairs, or expert advice, we put our customers first, ensuring that your pool is a safe and enjoyable oasis for you and your family. Let us handle your pool, so you can focus on making lasting memories! Waxahachie | Ennis | Duncanville | Cedar Hill | Midlothian | DeSoto | and MORE! Waxahachie | Ennis | Duncanville | Cedar Hill | Midlothian | DeSoto | and MORE! Waxahachie | Ennis | Duncanville | Cedar Hill | Midlothian | DeSoto | and MORE! Waxahachie | Ennis | Duncanville | Cedar Hill | Midlothian | DeSoto | and MORE! What We Do Scheduled Cleaning Regular pool cleaning is absolutely essential for ensuring both fun and safety. Our dedicated professional team works diligently to remove dirt, debris, and pesky algae, which guarantees that you have clear, sparkling water along with perfectly balanced chemicals. You can enjoy worry-free swims all season long! Equipment Repairs We expertly service, meticulously fix, and efficiently replace all types of pool equipment. This includes essential components such as heaters, filters, pumps, valves, timers, automation systems, water fillers, and even plumbing. Joint and Leak Repairs Specialized technicians focus on replacing the mastic joint around your pool. This important service keeps your pool structurally sound and helps prevent leaks. We also offer thorough skimmer repairs using techniques like foam injections to seal any water leaks. Your pool deserves top care, and we’re here to help. Who we are At A & M Pool Service and Repair, we love making every pool a sparkling oasis. Since we started in Waxahachie, we’ve focused on providing the best pool care our neighbors can find. We love to bring smiles to families by keeping the swimming going for as long as the season’s open and we’ve been doing just that for almost two decades now. Our mission? It’s right in the name: Service, period. We carefully assess each pool’s needs, whether it’s maintenance, repairs, or upgrades. Our skilled technicians spot issues that might not be obvious, keeping your pool in great shape all year. With a friendly attitude and a dedication to quality, we’ll ensure your pool is ready for gatherings or quiet evenings under the stars. Our inspiration is right in our comes from seeing our customers smile when they enjoy clear, clean water and from families having fun in their backyards. During cold snaps, we are there to fix broken equipment - saving untold thousands of dollars in potential home repair or equipment damage. During the record breaking hot Texas summers, we don’t miss a beat - showing up every time on time. Give us a holler and we’ll meet you for a free quote for what you need done. We are active in our community so if we cant help I’m sure we can point you in the direction of someone who can. Let us know what you need! Item 1 of 8 Real customers. Real Reviews. “I highly recommend A&M pool repair services to anyone in need of pool repair services. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction are truly commendable.” KE Colvin “In a world where people don't have to be nice and the art of professionalism is lost, the least we can do in responding is say "THANK YOU!" Thank you A&M Pool Service and Repair!!!” Jocqui Baker-Roberson “These guys are great! During the ice storm, my regular pool guy wouldn’t help me… I am handicapped thus can’t do much of anything. Called A & M, they came out that day, did everything needed and were the nicest people. I can’t say enough good things about them. They were very fair in their pricing and they have my business for as long as they want it!!! Thank you so much, and God bless you all!!!” Deborah Orlando Contact Us Let us know how we can help! Shoot us a message with your location and best way to get a hold of you and we’ll reach out as soon as possible. A & M Pool Ser vice and Repair info@ampoolservicerepair.com (214) 399-7347

reviews.text: Great guy to work with. I recently was having issues with my pool. Being sort of a DIY’er I tried sorting out the problem myself. After struggling for a couple of months with no success I called Thomas. He took the time to listen to me and discuss possible solutions. He said he thought my filter manifold was cracked. He  told me to come by the shop and he gave me a new manifold to install. He said put this in, if it fixes the issue, you can pay me; if not, just bring it back. Well it fixed the problem!
reviews.author: Mark Money

reviews.text:
One day this week, a plumbing line on our pool system started leaking. I called A&M after finding the number through a Google search. I found that the service was very delightful and thorough. This situation was pressing because we have 2 pool parties planned this week. Now, understanding how service works in business, I knew that my failing system does not constitute an emergency on the part of another. With that being said, I was hoping that they could get to my pool issue before the day of the party. When talking with Mr. Thomas he was so kind and helpful and wanted to get my problem taken care of as soon as possible.  He did exactly that! Within hours of my initial call my issue was fixed correctly and some nice pool tips were shared along the way.
In a world where people don't have to be nice and the art of professionalism is lost, the least we can do in responding is say "THANK YOU!"
Thank you A&M Pool Service and Repair!!!
I will recommend their service to others and use them again.
reviews.author: Jocqui Baker-Roberson

reviews.text: Best Pool Service in Waxahachie.  Had a scare this morning with one of my pool pumps.  Tommy came over right away to evaluate the situation and had Dillon come over and make the necessary repairs this afternoon.  Fast, knowledgeable and efficient service!
reviews.author: Ray Vickery

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of using the services of A&M Pool Service and Repair, and I must say, I am extremely impressed with their professionalism, expertise, and quality of work. From start to finish, my experience with them was nothing short of exceptional.

First and foremost, their customer service was outstanding. From the moment I contacted them, they were responsive, attentive, and genuinely interested in addressing my pool repair needs. They took the time to listen to my concerns, answer all of my questions, and provide me with a detailed explanation of the repair process.

The technician I can’t remember his name who came to repair my pool were highly skilled and knowledgeable. They arrived on time, equipped with all the necessary tools and equipment. They assessed the issues with my pool thoroughly and provided me with a transparent and fair estimate for the repairs. Throughout the entire process, they communicated effectively, keeping me informed of the progress and any unexpected findings.

I was particularly impressed with the quality of the repair work. The technicians demonstrated a great attention to detail, ensuring that every aspect of the repair was completed to the highest standard. They not only fixed the issues I had initially reported but also went above and beyond to identify and address any potential future problems.

The turnaround time for the repairs was impressive as well. They completed the work in a timely manner without compromising on the quality. I was thrilled to see my pool fully restored and functioning perfectly again.

Overall, I highly recommend A&M pool repair services to anyone in need of pool repair services. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction are truly commendable. With their exceptional service, my pool is now in top-notch condition, and I couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: KE Colvin

reviews.text: These guys are great!  During the ice storm,  my regular pool guy wouldn’t help me,  all I needed was the pool equipment turned off and drain.  I used him for three years and I am handicapped thus can’t do much of anything.  Called A & M,  they came out that day,  did everything needed and were the nicest people.  I can’t say enough good things about them.  They were very fair in their pricing and they have my business for as long as they want it!!!  Thank you so much,  and God bless you all!!!
reviews.author: Deborah Orlando

reviews.text: A&M Pool Service is one of the few companies left today that provides world class customer service with integrity and attention to detail.  I needed my pool pump and booster pump replaced, sweeper serviced, and filter cleaned.  They came out within two days.  Not only did they do the work, but Tom, the owner took the time to explain things to me and educate me on the entire system.  A week later one of the pipes was leaking, and Tom came back out to troubleshoot it with me and get it fixed. The folks at A&M Pool Service are professional, polite, and very informative.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND A&M POOL SERVICE!
reviews.author: Travis Hogan

reviews.text: My pool had extensive damage from the winter storm in February. After several failed commitments from other pool companies I found A&M Pool Service. Thomas was immediately responsive and went to work on solving my issue. He secured the equipment needed and had his guys out in a short period of time. They were very efficient and had me up and running in just a few hours. I highly recommend A&M Pool Service.
reviews.author: Ken Briggs

reviews.text: I was in a bit of a pickle.    My pool pump went out and my home warranty which will remain nameless,  AMERICAN HOME SHIELD,   Claimed they could not find an available vendor to dispatch.   I lived in a remote area.  They wouldn’t respond to my request for service, each time I called I was on hold forever only to speak to outsourced call centers who couldn’t commit when I would be contacted by a vendor.   After five days I called A   and M Pool service and repair, explained my situation.   By that evening the owner sent his nephew who lived nearby and fixed my pump.    Thomas, the owner was very professional, personal and extremely responsive.   He genuinely cares about his customers and goes above and beyond.   I highly recommend Thomas and A and M Pool Service and Repair.
reviews.author: Ernesto Rodriguez
